data.adjustment: Adj Close execution; historical share-basis screens; SEC diluted-share market-cap proxy

warnings: This trial uses a fixed current-symbol universe and may contain survivorship and selection bias.
SEC fundamentals use complete annual 10-K accessions and become available on the next trading session after filing.
Latest annual flow facts remain in force until the next complete 10-K and are not quarterly-updated TTM values; amendments apply prospectively and never backfill prior rows.
Price and volume screens use Yahoo's contemporaneous historical share basis; later splits change units without changing dollar volume.

Screening market capitalization is a proxy built from Yahoo split-adjusted raw Close and SEC diluted weighted-average shares normalized to the same share basis; it can differ from period-end equity market capitalization.
Raw SEC and Yahoo responses are fetched at run time and are not bundled; the normalized input panels are content-hashed.
Complete annual SEC filing events by symbol: AAPL=18, MSFT=16, GOOGL=10, AMZN=16, META=13, NVDA=16, WMT=16, HD=16, CAT=16, CVX=16, JNJ=14, PG=17, KO=16, PEP=16, COST=16.
Yahoo can revise historical adjusted prices or corporate actions, so a later refetch may have a different dataset hash.
137 bars were used only for indicator warmup and excluded from performance.
The evaluation starts as a new cash portfolio using the latest pre-start target; pre-start holdings and stop state are not carried forward.
No out-of-sample interval is designated, so forwardReturn is null.
Stops trigger on the close and fill at the next bar close, so gaps can exceed the configured threshold.
Strategy prices are dividend-adjusted while ^GSPC is a price index, so return bases are not identical.
